Forces this class to be categorized as an enum and determines how it is handled in the model.

A class must have at least one `value`, at least one property, and cannot have a composite primary key to be an enum.

This property can be `class` to represent the enum as a class (with enums for the primary key and unique keys), or `true` to represent it fully as an enum.

If the class can be an enum and the domain of its primary key is not auto-generated, it defaults to a `class` enum.
